contentList.content: Monks of the Way of the Kensei train relentlessly with their weapons, to the point that the weapon becomes like an extension of the body. Founded on a mastery of sword fighting, the tradition has expanded to include many different weapons.
Attack with an <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_UnarmedAttack">unarmed strike</LSTag> while you are holding a melee weapon.
Hit a target with a part of your body while you are wielding a melee weapon.
Hit a target with a part of your body while you are wielding a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KENSEI_WEAPON_EQUIPPED">kensei weapon</LSTag>.
Your special martial arts training leads you to master the use of certain weapons. Weapons of the chosen types count as monk weapons for you.
Your special martial arts training leads you to master the use of certain melee weapons. Weapons of the chosen types count as monk weapons for you.
Your special martial arts training leads you to master the use of certain ranged weapons. Weapons of the chosen types count as monk weapons for you.
Must be wielding a kensei weapon.
Must be wielding a melee kensei weapon.
Must be wielding a ranged kensei weapon.

You have <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> with weapons of the chosen type. In addition, they count as a <LSTag Tooltip="MonkWeapon">monk weapons</LSTag> for you and may be used with any abilities that require a kensei weapon.
Can use abilities that require Kensei weapons.
You have received instruction in the deft strokes of various forms of art.

If you make an unarmed strike as part of the Attack action on your turn and are holding a melee <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KENSEI_WEAPON_EQUIPPED">kensei weapon</LSTag>, you gain a +[1] bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> until the start of your next turn.
This effect will not apply if the melee kensei weapon leaves your hand or you are <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="INCAPACITATED">incapacitated</LSTag>.
Entity has a +[1] bonus to AC while wielding a melee kensei weapon.
Weapon is being used defensively as part of <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="AgileParry">Agile Parry</LSTag>
Deal an additional [1] with ranged <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KENSEI_WEAPON_EQUIPPED">kensei weapon</LSTag>.
Deals an additional [1] with ranged <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KENSEI_WEAPON_EQUIPPED">kensei weapons</LSTag>.

Your attacks with your kensei weapons count as magical for the purpose of overcoming <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">resistance</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">immunity</LSTag> to nonmagical attacks and damage.

Weapon counts as magical for the purpose of overcoming <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">resistance</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">immunity</LSTag> to nonmagical attacks and damage when wielded by a Monk following the Way of the Kensei.
Once on each of your turns when you hit a target with a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KENSEI_WEAPON_EQUIPPED">kensei weapon</LSTag>, deal an additional [1] damage.
Deft Strike will be available to use again next turn.
Choose whether your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SharepentheBlade_Container">Sharpen the Blade</LSTag> ability will target the weapon in your main or off hand.

Your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SharepentheBlade_Container">Sharpen the Blade</LSTag> ability will target the <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KENSEI_WEAPON_EQUIPPED">kensei weapon</LSTag> in your main hand.

Your<LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SharepentheBlade_Container">Sharpen the Blade</LSTag> ability will target the <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KENSEI_WEAPON_EQUIPPED">kensei weapon</LSTag> in your off hand.

Grant a nonmagical <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KENSEI_WEAPON_EQUIPPED">kensei weapon</LSTag> a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="KiPoint">ki points</LSTag> you spend.
Grant a nonmagical <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KENSEI_WEAPON_EQUIPPED">kensei weapon</LSTag> +[1] to attack and damage rolls.
The effect on the target weapon will end early if you use this ability again.
Must have a nonmagical kensei weapon in active Weapon Set.
Weapon has a +[1] bonus to attack and damage rolls.
The effect on the weapon will end early if <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_SharepentheBlade_Container">Sharpen the Blade</LSTag> is used again.
Once on each of your turns, you may reroll a missed attack made with a <LSTag Tooltip="MonkWeapon">monk weapon</LSTag>.
Reroll a missed attack made with a <LSTag Tooltip="MonkWeapon">monk weapons</LSTag>.
